title_o: Where do we look during potentially offensive behavior?
verdict_reason: Amsterdam_data.txt (OSF mkyvt) has 120 rows = 30 participants x 4 discussants with Looktime, Discussant, Condi; a mixed ANOVA with Greenhouse-Geisser correction reproduces the interaction F=1.401, p=.254, partial eta^2=.0476 exactly. Subject ids are absent and inferred from row order, as the script does.

data_files.notes: long format, no subject column; rows ordered by Discussant, subject = position within block
MATLAB preprocessing from raw eye-tracker files to look times
listed only: ~41 pp*.txt raw files; named 'Part 1', no part 2 in the Data child

key_test.test: mixed ANOVA, Discussant (4, within) x Condi (2, between) on Looktime; interaction, GG-corrected p

obstacles: no subject identifier; pairing by row order (exact match with the table supports it)
raw eye-tracking zip labelled Part 1 only
